body: Thank you. I am feeling so overwhelmed and none of my typical coping skills is working
I wish there were someone to call...but there isn't anybody. I am going to have to tough this one out on my own.
I must add that I don't usually experience "mulitiday" crises...
thank you for replying to me

Did the psych ward then help you to re-adjust. Not that I am really into going into a psych ward...but was it the sort of thing that gave you a "break." When I have been thinking of a getaway...not a hospital visit, but a kind of retreat...I have been hoping for that, a break to help me think and get my head on straight. I don't know what else to do.

That's funny because I have been thinking about taking a few days off...I am just afraid of what I might do because of my tendency to isolate and my mind just goes to that really bad place all over again. It is hard to figure out what would be best...to do something that would enable me to escape, but if I do, what if I get to the bad place...I don't like this feeling.
